name: meta-ads-library-pp-mcp
description: Active public Meta ads worldwide (plus EU/UK/BR and political archives) from one static binary — zero browser, zero API key required, plus local SQLite competitive intelligence.

meta_access_token.title: META_ACCESS_TOKEN (optional — official archive only)
meta_access_token.description: Optional Meta Graph API access token needed only for the official v27.0 ads_archive (`archive`) tool. Leave blank for zero-auth public commercial ad search, advertiser lookup, ad details, and local intelligence tools.

meta_ads_archive_token.title: META_ADS_ARCHIVE_TOKEN (optional alias)
meta_ads_archive_token.description: Optional fallback alias for META_ACCESS_TOKEN used only by the official `archive` tool when META_ACCESS_TOKEN is unset. Public tools require no token.

facebook_access_token.title: FACEBOOK_ACCESS_TOKEN (optional alias)
facebook_access_token.description: Optional fallback alias for META_ACCESS_TOKEN used only by the official `archive` tool when META_ACCESS_TOKEN and META_ADS_ARCHIVE_TOKEN are unset. Public tools require no token.
